original.description: A .303-inch Vickers machine gun with its tripod mount, belt, ammunition box and condenser can, from the collection of the York Castle Museum, released to Wikimedia Commons by York Museums Trust under a GLAMwiki partnership. The record is a museum catalogue record: title ".303inch Vickers Machine Gun", accession number YORCM : CA78.a-c, department Social History, object dated between 1914 and 1918, and the museum's own description — "The Vickers Gun was the standard British machine gun from 1912. It was heavy and mounted on a tripod, requiring a team of six men to transport it to and operate it on the battlefield."
original.photographer: York Museums Trust — the record credits the trust rather than an individual photographer
original.date: catalogued image released through the York Museums Trust GLAMwiki donation; the object is dated 1914–1918 by the museum
original.archive: York Castle Museum, York; York Museums Trust, accession YORCM : CA78.a-c; via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Commons record: LicenseShortName "CC BY-SA 4.0"; UsageTerms "Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0"; AttributionRequired true; credit line on the record: "Courtesy of York Museums Trust"). Attribution to York Museums Trust is mandatory and the share-alike condition applies to derivatives.

colorization.status: not colorized, and must not be — a modern colour photograph of the object, and the licence is share-alike.

content_policy: ok — a museum object photographed on its own; no casualties
caption: The .303-inch Vickers, the British heavy machine gun of 1914, with its tripod, belt and condenser can. York Castle Museum, YORCM : CA78.a-c.
